slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Graphs
slides.narration: Let's solve River Sizes, a medium graphs problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: In a 0/1 matrix, sizes of all 4-directionally connected groups of 1s (any order).
slides.narration: Here's the problem. In a 0 or 1 matrix, sizes of all 4-directionally connected groups of 1s (any order).

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Each river is a connected component of ones; flood-fill to measure it.
